apis.description: Retrieve the paginated list of calendar events or assignments for the current user

operations.notes: Retrieve the paginated list of calendar events or assignments for the current user

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Defaults to "event"

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description:
Only return events since the start_date (inclusive).
Defaults to today. The value should be formatted as: yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description:
Only return events before the end_date (inclusive).
Defaults to start_date. The value should be formatted as: yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.
If end_date is the same as start_date, then only events on that day are
returned.

parameters.name: undated
parameters.description:
Defaults to false (dated events only).
If true, only return undated events and ignore start_date and end_date.

parameters.name: all_events
parameters.description:
Defaults to false (uses start_date, end_date, and undated criteria).
If true, all events are returned, ignoring start_date, end_date, and undated criteria.

parameters.name: context_codes
parameters.description:
List of context codes of courses, groups, users, or accounts whose events you want to see.
If not specified, defaults to the current user (i.e personal calendar,
no course/group events). Limited to 10 context codes, additional ones are
ignored. The format of this field is the context type, followed by an
underscore, followed by the context id. For example: course_42

parameters.name: excludes
parameters.description: Array of attributes to exclude. Possible values are "description", "child_events" and "assignment"

parameters.name: includes
parameters.description: Array of optional attributes to include. Possible values are "web_conference" and "series_natural_language"

parameters.name: important_dates
parameters.description:
Defaults to false.
If true, only events with important dates set to true will be returned.

parameters.name: blackout_date
parameters.description:
Defaults to false.
If true, only events with blackout date set to true will be returned.

apis.description: Create and return a new calendar event

operations.notes: Create and return a new calendar event

parameters.name: calendar_event[context_code]
parameters.description:
Context code of the course, group, user, or account whose calendar
this event should be added to.

parameters.name: calendar_event[title]
parameters.description: Short title for the calendar event.

parameters.name: calendar_event[description]
parameters.description: Longer HTML description of the event.

parameters.name: calendar_event[start_at]
parameters.description: Start date/time of the event.

parameters.name: calendar_event[end_at]
parameters.description: End date/time of the event.

parameters.name: calendar_event[location_name]
parameters.description: Location name of the event.

parameters.name: calendar_event[location_address]
parameters.description: Location address

parameters.name: calendar_event[time_zone_edited]
parameters.description:
Time zone of the user editing the event. Allowed time zones are
{http://www.iana.org/time-zones IANA time zones} or friendlier
{http://api.rubyonrails.org/classes/ActiveSupport/TimeZone.html Ruby on Rails time zones}.

parameters.name: calendar_event[all_day]
parameters.description: When true event is considered to span the whole day and times are ignored.

parameters.name: calendar_event[child_event_data][X][start_at]
parameters.description:
Section-level start time(s) if this is a course event. X can be any
identifier, provided that it is consistent across the start_at, end_at
and context_code

parameters.name: calendar_event[child_event_data][X][end_at]
parameters.description: Section-level end time(s) if this is a course event.

parameters.name: calendar_event[child_event_data][X][context_code]
parameters.description: Context code(s) corresponding to the section-level start and end time(s).

parameters.name: calendar_event[duplicate][count]
parameters.description: Number of times to copy/duplicate the event.  Count cannot exceed 200.

parameters.name: calendar_event[duplicate][interval]
parameters.description: Defaults to 1 if duplicate `count` is set.  The interval between the duplicated events.

parameters.name: calendar_event[duplicate][frequency]
parameters.description: Defaults to "weekly".  The frequency at which to duplicate the event

parameters.name: calendar_event[duplicate][append_iterator]
parameters.description:
Defaults to false.  If set to `true`, an increasing counter number will be appended to the event title
when the event is duplicated.  (e.g. Event 1, Event 2, Event 3, etc)

parameters.name: calendar_event[rrule]
calendar_event[blackout_date]
parameters.description:
If the blackout_date is true, this event represents a holiday or some
other special day that does not count in course pacing.

apis.description:
Creates and updates "timetable" events for a course.
Can automaticaly generate a series of calendar events based on simple schedules
(e.g. "Monday and Wednesday at 2:00pm" )

Existing timetable events for the course and course sections
will be updated if they still are part of the timetable.
Otherwise, they will be deleted.

operations.notes:
Creates and updates "timetable" events for a course.
Can automaticaly generate a series of calendar events based on simple schedules
(e.g. "Monday and Wednesday at 2:00pm" )

Existing timetable events for the course and course sections
will be updated if they still are part of the timetable.
Otherwise, they will be deleted.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: timetables[course_section_id]
parameters.description:
An array of timetable objects for the course section specified by course_section_id.
If course_section_id is set to "all", events will be created for the entire course.

parameters.name: timetables[course_section_id][weekdays]
parameters.description:
A comma-separated list of abbreviated weekdays
(Mon-Monday, Tue-Tuesday, Wed-Wednesday, Thu-Thursday, Fri-Friday, Sat-Saturday, Sun-Sunday)

parameters.name: timetables[course_section_id][start_time]
parameters.description: Time to start each event at (e.g. "9:00 am")

parameters.name: timetables[course_section_id][end_time]
parameters.description: Time to end each event at (e.g. "9:00 am")

parameters.name: timetables[course_section_id][location_name]
parameters.description: A location name to set for each event

apis.description:
Creates and updates "timetable" events for a course or course section.
Similar to {api:CalendarEventsApiController#set_course_timetable setting a course timetable},
but instead of generating a list of events based on a timetable schedule,
this endpoint expects a complete list of events.

operations.summary: Create or update events directly for a course timetable
operations.notes:
Creates and updates "timetable" events for a course or course section.
Similar to {api:CalendarEventsApiController#set_course_timetable setting a course timetable},
but instead of generating a list of events based on a timetable schedule,
this endpoint expects a complete list of events.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: course_section_id
parameters.description:
Events will be created for the course section specified by course_section_id.
If not present, events will be created for the entire course.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: An array of event objects to use.

parameters.name: events[start_at]
parameters.description: Start time for the event

parameters.name: events[end_at]
parameters.description: End time for the event

parameters.name: events[location_name]
parameters.description: Location name for the event

parameters.name: events[code]
parameters.description:
A unique identifier that can be used to update the event at a later time
If one is not specified, an identifier will be generated based on the start and end times

parameters.name: events[title]
parameters.description: Title for the meeting. If not present, will default to the associated course's name

id.description: The ID of the calendar event

title.description: The title of the calendar event

start_at.description: The start timestamp of the event

end_at.description: The end timestamp of the event

description.description: The HTML description of the event

location_name.description: The location name of the event

location_address.description: The address where the event is taking place

context_code.description: the context code of the calendar this event belongs to (course, group, user, or account)

effective_context_code.description: if specified, it indicates which calendar this event should be displayed on. for example, a section-level event would have the course's context code here, while the section's context code would be returned above)

context_name.description: the context name of the calendar this event belongs to (course, user or group)

all_context_codes.description: a comma-separated list of all calendar contexts this event is part of

workflow_state.description: Current state of the event ('active', 'locked' or 'deleted') 'locked' indicates that start_at/end_at cannot be changed (though the event could be deleted). Normally only reservations or time slots with reservations are locked (see the Appointment Groups API)

hidden.description: Whether this event should be displayed on the calendar. Only true for course-level events with section-level child events.

parent_event_id.description: Normally null. If this is a reservation (see the Appointment Groups API), the id will indicate the time slot it is for. If this is a section-level event, this will be the course-level parent event.

child_events_count.description: The number of child_events. See child_events (and parent_event_id)

child_events.description: Included by default, but may be excluded (see include[] option). If this is a time slot (see the Appointment Groups API) this will be a list of any reservations. If this is a course-level event, this will be a list of section-level events (if any)

url.description: URL for this calendar event (to update, delete, etc.)

html_url.description: URL for a user to view this event

all_day.description: Boolean indicating whether this is an all-day event (midnight to midnight)

created_at.description: When the calendar event was created

updated_at.description: When the calendar event was last updated

appointment_group_id.description: Various Appointment-Group-related fields.These fields are only pertinent to time slots (appointments) and reservations of those time slots. See the Appointment Groups API. The id of the appointment group

appointment_group_url.description: The API URL of the appointment group

own_reservation.description: If the event is a reservation, this a boolean indicating whether it is the current user's reservation, or someone else's

reserve_url.description: If the event is a time slot, the API URL for reserving it

reserved.description: If the event is a time slot, a boolean indicating whether the user has already made a reservation for it

participant_type.description: The type of participant to sign up for a slot: 'User' or 'Group'

participants_per_appointment.description: If the event is a time slot, this is the participant limit

available_slots.description: If the event is a time slot and it has a participant limit, an integer indicating how many slots are available

user.description: If the event is a user-level reservation, this will contain the user participant JSON (refer to the Users API).

group.description: If the event is a group-level reservation, this will contain the group participant JSON (refer to the Groups API).

important_dates.description: Boolean indicating whether this has important dates.

series_uuid.description: Identifies the recurring event series this event may belong to.

rrule.description: An iCalendar RRULE for defining how events in a recurring event series repeat.

series_head.description: Boolean indicating if is the first event in the series of recurring events.

series_natural_language.description: A natural language expression of how events occur in the series.

blackout_date.description: Boolean indicating whether this has blackout date.

id.description: A synthetic ID for the assignment

start_at.description: The due_at timestamp of the assignment

end_at.description: The due_at timestamp of the assignment

description.description: The HTML description of the assignment

context_code.description: the context code of the (course) calendar this assignment belongs to

workflow_state.description: Current state of the assignment ('published' or 'deleted')

url.description: URL for this assignment (note that updating/deleting should be done via the Assignments API)

html_url.description: URL for a user to view this assignment

all_day_date.description: The due date of this assignment

all_day.description: Boolean indicating whether this is an all-day event (e.g. assignment due at midnight)

updated_at.description: When the assignment was last updated

assignment.description: The full assignment JSON data (See the Assignments API)

assignment_overrides.description: The list of AssignmentOverrides that apply to this event (See the Assignments API). This information is useful for determining which students or sections this assignment-due event applies to.

important_dates.description: Boolean indicating whether this has important dates.

rrule.description: An iCalendar RRULE for defining how events in a recurring event series repeat.

series_head.description: Trueif this is the first event in the series of recurring events.

series_natural_language.description: A natural language expression of how events occur in the series.
